Name: Unlock Casks Without a Cellar
Author: Regnander
Description:
[i][b]Note: This mod has only been tested on local multiplayer.[/b][/i]

Want to start aging wine and cheese, but love your house just the way it is? Instead of being forced to expand your home, this mod allows you to unlock Casks by reaching skill levels of your choice.

By default, casks will not age items unless they are placed in a cellar. You need to install a mod that enables aging in any location (for example [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642]Custom Cask Mod[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7678]Cask Enabled Sheds[/url]) alongside this mod.

[size=4]Language support[/size]
This mod is machine-translated into all in-game languages. If you have suggestions for better wording, please let me know in the Posts tab.

[size=4]Configuration[/size]
You can customize the required skill levels by editing the [b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]config.json[/font][/b] file in the mod folder, or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in-game.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41494/41494-1768958582-563191433.png[/img]

[quote][b]Important![/b]
Changing the skill requirements to a higher level after you have already unlocked the recipe will [i][b]not[/b][/i] remove it from your crafting list.[/quote]
[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings directly in-game.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
